title: Кібератака групи UAC-0057 (unc1151) на державні організації України з  використанням шкідливої програми MicroBackdoor (CERT-UA#4109)

entities.name: UAC-0057
entities.gloss: A threat actor group, also known as UNC1151, associated with cyber espionage activities.

entities.name: Mandiant
entities.gloss: An American cybersecurity firm providing threat intelligence and incident response services.

entities.name: Dmytro Oleksiuk
entities.gloss: A software developer and security researcher also known by the alias cr4sh.

entities.name: MicroBackdoor
entities.gloss: An open-source C++ backdoor malware designed for remote access and control of compromised systems.

entities.name: довідка.zip
entities.gloss: A malicious ZIP archive containing a Compiled HTML Help file used as an initial infection vector.

entities.name: dovidka.chm
entities.gloss: A malicious Microsoft Compiled HTML Help file containing decoy and dropper components.

entities.name: image.jpg
entities.gloss: A decoy image file detailing procedures during artillery shelling.

entities.name: file.htm
entities.gloss: A malicious HTML Application file containing embedded VBScript code.

entities.name: ignit.vbs
entities.gloss: A malicious VBScript dropper responsible for decoding and dropping secondary payloads.

entities.name: core.dll
entities.gloss: A malicious .NET loader DLL that decodes and executes the MicroBackdoor payload.

entities.name: desktop.ini
entities.gloss: A malicious script file used to launch the core.dll loader using regasm.exe.

entities.name: Windows Prefetch.lNk
entities.gloss: A malicious Windows shortcut file placed in the startup folder for persistence.

entities.name: microbackdoor.dll
entities.gloss: A dynamic-link library file containing the compiled MicroBackdoor payload.

entities.name: xbeta.online
entities.gloss: A malicious domain name configured as a command-and-control server.
An IP address associated with malicious command-and-control infrastructure.

relations.head: UAC-0057
relations.evidence: Активність асоційовано з діяльністю групи UAC-0057

relations.head: довідка.zip
relations.evidence: файл "довідка.zip", який містить файл контекстної довідки (Microsoft Compiled HTML Help) "dovidka.chm"

relations.head: dovidka.chm
relations.evidence: Згаданий CHM-файл, у свою чергу, містить зображення-приманку "image.jpg"

relations.head: dovidka.chm
relations.evidence: CHM-файл, у свою чергу, містить... та HTA-файл "file.htm"

relations.head: file.htm
relations.evidence: Виконання останнього призведе до створення на комп'ютері і запуску дропера "ignit.vbs"

relations.head: core.dll
relations.evidence: .NET-лоадер здійснить декодування і виконання шкідливої програми MicroBackdoor
